_comment: Deterministic age = max(rating_floor[rated], category_floor[category][severity]) + stacking bumps. Edit numbers here, push, and the site rebuilds without refetching. Ratings not listed (N/A, Not Rated, Approved, Passed, TV-*) contribute no floor, so the Parents Guide alone decides.

stacking._comment: Optional bumps when several categories are heavy at once. Set counts to 0 to disable.
